name: 12561 · New Paltz, NY
findings: ZIP 12561 (New Paltz) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (65%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12561 (New Paltz) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12561 (New Paltz) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
